cds.title: Ball State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF; file cds-2025-26.pdf, page headers still read 2024-2025 but the data are the Fall 2025 entering class and 2026-27 costs)

ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 first-time first-year): 22,193 applied, 19,141 admitted (86%); international 1,520 applied and 1,443 admitted (95%), 42 enrolled. SAT/ACT figures describe enrolled students: 31% submitted SAT (1,156) but only 1% ACT (21), so the ACT percentiles rest on very few students. No early decision or early action; no waitlist. The admission-factor checkboxes could not be read from the PDF text and are not shown. Undergraduate enrollment is 15,950 (total undergraduates); the nonresident count could not be read, so the number of international undergraduates is not shown.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2027): SAT or ACT not required for admission, but considered if submitted; Ball State is test-optional and the student may elect to submit scores.

cost.notes: First-year costs from the Common Data Set (2026-27): in-state tuition $8,948, nonresident tuition $27,496 (international students pay the nonresident rate), required fees $2,134, on-campus food and housing $12,832; books $782. Tuition varies by program. Only non-need-based aid from the college is available to nonresidents; 189 nonresidents received aid from the college, average $19,716
